title: Async attention warmup slot skew causing subtle token shift & KV index misalignment
creator: Maya Chen
description: Observed correctness regressions (token duplication / subtle token shift and softmax normalization drift) in mixed-precision fused-attention path that correlate with recent async warmup optimization for attention kernels. Issue surfaces under high-concurrency prefill→decode handoff, especially when warmup threads activate speculative kernel slots.
reproduction_steps: 1) Run long chat workload (GPT-like) with throughput >= 600 req/s and hybrid prefill/decode split; 2) Use model vetting profile with seq_len=1024, fp16 quantization; 3) Enable async attention warmup (feature flag: runtime.async_attn_warmup=true) and speculative-kernel slots (runtime.spec_slots=2); 4) Send deterministic prompt set with token-level checksums collected at generation time; 5) Observe occasional token duplication and later token index shift after KV cache rotation.
investigation_notes: - Initial flamegraphs show warmup threads racing with decode thread during KV slot prefetch. - Memory inspector finds KV-index pointer incremented twice in rare interleavings causing downstream decode to read shifted slots. - Numeric drift observed in softmax when fused kernel fallback occurs mid-affine-scaling due to mixed-precision rounding and partial prefill kv snapshots. - Repro rate ~0.4% on stress harness with 64 concurrent async workers; higher when sequence length and batching skewed.
timeline: 2026-03-10: Incident reported by QA stress harness. 2026-03-11: Reproducer added to infra with deterministic seed. 2026-03-11: Initial bisect narrowed to async warmup commit c3f9a (kernel scheduling refactor). 2026-03-12: Local PoC guard inserted to serialize warmup->decode handoff; repro rate dropped to 0.01%.
recent_activity: 2026-03-10: Maya Chen created ticket with failing batch logs and checksums.
2026-03-11: Diego Alvarez added reproducer and stress script (link below).
2026-03-11: Benchmarks run with/without async warmup to compare: async=0.4% repro, sync=0%
2026-03-12: Engineering sync — decided to ship temporary gate and prioritize deterministic fix before runtime-1.20 release.
decision: Ship a short-term mitigation (feature-flagged serialization of warmup handoff) to eliminate race, then implement deterministic slot reservation protocol in scheduler. No rollback of recent perf commits; instead opt for guard to preserve perf for non-repro paths.
mitigation: Applied feature flag runtime.async_attn_warmup=false for affected fleets and rolled gate into staging. Merged WIP PoC guard to reduce repro. WIP hotfix branch runtime/hotfix/ENG-158902-guard created.
next_steps: 1) Implement slot reservation API in scheduler to atomically claim KV slots before warmup starts (owner token and seq id).
2) Add CAS (compare-and-swap) protection around KV-index increments and extend tests for interleaving windows.
3) Introduce softmax numerical regression tests across mixed-precision fallback boundaries.
4) Run 48h stress on staging with feature-flag enabled and verify repro <0.001%
5) Review and land deterministic fix into runtime-1.20 and backport to runtime-1.19.
